description:
Welcome to No. 55 Heathfield, beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached family home, located in a sought-after part of Kinnegad with easy access to M4 & M6 motorways. This attractive property overlooking a green area is immaculately presented from the outside in, including new front door, tarmac driveway, walled front garden, pedestrian side gate and a well-maintained East facing back garden.
A bright welcoming hallway with tiled flooring, carpeted stairs and guest WC with tiled floor and wash hand basin. The main living room is a generous and light-filled space with wood laminate floor, timber surround fireplace with solid fuel open fire. Double doors lead to the open plan kitchen/dining area with ample storage with fitted units on both sides of the room, tiled splash back and flooring, kitchen appliances included and new French doors in dining area.
Upstairs, the home continues with three bright bedrooms with laminate flooring and storage is in no short supply with generous, fitted wardrobes in all bedrooms. The master suite benefits from a contemporary, tiled en-suite with wash hand basin, WC and new power shower. A stylish family bathroom, newly renovated, fully tiled, features a WC, vanity unit, and corner shower cubicle with electric shower and doors
Presented in pristine, showhouse condition, this home includes some kitchen appliances, blinds, and garden shed. The property is ideally located close to the GAA pitch, shops and everyday amenities. With primary school on your doorstep and easy access to larger towns via well-connected roadways, this is an ideal opportunity, and viewing is highly recommended.
